meta.description: Journey F: optional outreach to Salesforce-created leads. SHIPS DISABLED (workflow inactive + config outreach_journey_f.enabled=false). Lead existence is NOT consent (ASSUMPTIONS A-18): every send requires mapped consent fields, freshness, suppression checks, idempotency and messaging hours — then still passes the full SB-06 guard set.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const m = (JSON.parse($env.SF_FIELD_MAP_JSON || '{}').mappings || {}); const req = ['mobile_phone','sms_consent','consent_source','consent_timestamp','sms_opt_out','human_takeover','ai_enabled','last_outbound_date']; const f = {}; for (const k of req) { const s = m[k]; f[k] = s && s.field !== 'UNMAPPED' && s.object === 'Lead' ? s.field : null; } if (!f.sms_consent || !f.consent_source || !f.consent_timestamp || !f.mobile_phone) return 'SELECT Id FROM Lead WHERE Id = null'; const sel = ['Id','FirstName','CreatedDate', ...Object.values(f).filter(Boolean)]; const conds = [`${f.sms_consent} = true`, `${f.mobile_phone} != null`, f.sms_opt_out ? `${f.sms_opt_out} = false` : null, f.human_takeover ? `${f.human_takeover} = false` : null, f.ai_enabled ? `${f.ai_enabled} = true` : null, f.last_outbound_date ? `${f.last_outbound_date} = null` : null, `CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:7`].filter(Boolean); return `SELECT ${[...new Set(sel)].join(', ')} FROM Lead WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')} LIMIT 50`; })() }}

options.$comment: Returns zero rows unless consent_source/consent_timestamp/sms_consent/mobile_phone are ALL mapped — unmapped consent means no outreach, ever.

parameters.$comment: Idempotency: the SB-06 key is correlation+recipient+content; correlation embeds record id + run — a re-run the same day re-attempts, but last_outbound_date (stamped by SB-06) excludes the lead from the eligibility query, satisfying 'no prior same outreach'.
